products.name: Vellux® Renew Blanket
products.description:
The Trusted Classic — Reinvented for Today’s Guest Experience

For over 65 years, the Vellux ® Blanket has established the standard for comfort, durability, and timeless appeal. This updated version of the Vellux ® -branded blanket remains cozy yet breathable, lightweight yet warm.

Crafted from 100% polyester, the chenille Vellux ® Renew Blanket features a velvety-soft texture that gently insulates without bulk, helping guests stay warm and comfortable while allowing for an energy-efficient thermostat setting . It is heavier than its predecessor, with a 260 GSM offering year-round versatility for any room or climate.

Exceptionally durable, with 1" lockstitch hems on all four sides . Vellux ® Renew is machine washable , maintaining its plush feel and clean look—no pilling, matting, or shedding . P erfect for layering or standalone use , this updated version is hypoallergenic and fast drying.

Designed for modern spaces, it is offered in a curated palette of on-trend colors, the Vellux ® Blanket effortlessly complements today’s design-forward hospitality interiors. Whether used in-room, on extra bedding shelves, or in guest closets, it’s a versatile staple your guests will appreciate—and your team will trust.
